title: Trace of the word-comparison machine
statement: Let $M$ be the comparison machine on $k$ work tapes, with distinct tape indices $f$ and $s$. Let $u,v$ be finite words over a type with decidable equality, and let $d$ be a configuration in the run phase. Suppose tapes $f$ and $s$, respectively, contain $u$ and $v$ at every offset from $-1$ through their word lengths, with blank cells outside each word, relative to their current head positions. Suppose also that an index $\delta\le\min(|u|,|v|)$ has matching symbols at every earlier index, has no symbol present in both words at index $\delta$, and the two words are equal exactly when their symbols-or-absence at $\delta$ agree. Then for every time $t$, the run of the comparison machine from $d$ is the corresponding piecewise trace: its forward configuration at time $t$ for $t\le\delta$, its rewind configuration with verdict indicating whether $u=v$ at index $2\delta+1-t$ for $\delta<t\le2\delta+1$, and thereafter its completed configuration with that same verdict.
hypotheses_covered: A symbol type with decidable equality
Initial configuration is in the run phase
Tape $f$ contains $u$ and tape $s$ contains $v$ over offsets $-1$ through their respective lengths, relative to the heads
The words agree at all indices less than $\delta$
No symbol is present in both words at index $\delta$
The options at index $\delta$ agree if and only if $u=v$
